issues.description: The template repository contains inconsistent default sizes for the fixed-point type (FIX_LEN) between the example program and the test harness. example_program/src/math_fix.c defines FIX_LEN as 8 (8-byte fix_t) while tests/src/math_fix.h defines FIX_LEN as 4 (4-byte fix_t). The assembly examples and helper example code in the template use 64-bit (8-byte) fixed-point conventions (push pairs, read low/high dwords), so the test harness assuming 32-bit fix_t creates a structural type mismatch that will confuse students and can cause the provided tests to behave incorrectly or fail to match the intended calling conventions.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the FIX_LEN default consistent across the template (tests and example_program) so students aren't faced with conflicting fixed-point sizes. Options: (a) Change tests/src/math_fix.h in the template to define FIX_LEN as 8 to match example_program and the assembly examples; or (b) change example_program/src/math_fix.c and the assembly examples to use FIX_LEN 4 and adjust examples accordingly. Preferably centralize the FIX_LEN definition (or expose it as a single Makefile/macro) so both the example program and test harness use the same value.
